evals.prompt: We're a consumer protection law firm. Here's a draft blog post for our website about debt collector lawsuits (collector-lawsuit-draft.md). Review it and make it credible and authoritative before we publish — we want Google and AI tools to take it seriously.
evals.expected_output: A revised article plus an E-E-A-T audit: letter-by-letter signal table with Present/Partial/Missing, false absolutes removed ('always beat them', 'never lose', '$1,000 guaranteed'), FDCPA claims made accurate and hedged, CLIENT INPUT NEEDED list (byline, verifiable case stats) instead of invented credentials, primary-source citations added, off-page recommendations kept separate.
